component-o.description-s: JST GH top-entry (vertical) SMT header, 1x2, 1.25 mm pitch, tin, 1.0 A per contact (AWG 26), 50 V, -25~85 C. LED sub-board link: pin 1 LED drive (anode), pin 2 return (cathode, ground). Mates with GHR-02V-S / SSHL-002T-P0.2.

connector-o.contact_resistance_source-s: JST GH catalog p1: Contact resistance: Initial value 30 mOhm max; after environmental tests 50 mOhm max
connector-o.board_area_note_s: bounding rect of courtyard and mate keepout

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: JST GH catalog: top-entry header, housing GHR-02V-S 3.75 x 4.15 x 5.7 (p2 table); keepout adds 2 mm on the latch side for the release finger; mated height estimated as for BM14B-GHS-TBT
